1.question:
You are given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

You can return the answer in any order. If you want to beat 100% in the aspect of time, What the algorithm you should use?
1.analysis:
这是Leetcode上经典的两数之和：给你一个整数数组和目标值，求数组里面任意两个数之和能求这个目标数字的下标
暴力破解就是双层遍历这个数组，然后判断值，时间复杂度为`O(n^2)`，数组排序+二分查找+线性查找，用二分快速查找两个数字是否能求出和，在用线性查找找出这两个数字的下标，时间复杂度约为`O(nlogn)`，有序哈希map和无序哈希map都能实现这个功能，但是有序哈希map增删改查平均是`O(logn)`，而无序哈希map平均情况是`O(1)`，但我们不用考虑有序，我们只需要遍历一次数组，把每个数值的差和当前数组的下标记录到map中，然后每次查询是否存在即可，在选择无序map，最坏时间复杂度是`O(n)`，所以答案故选C

7.question:
Jin Ming was very happy today, the new house he bought at home will have to take the key, and there is a very spacious room for himself. What makes him even more happy is that his mother said to him yesterday: "What items your room needs to buy, how to arrange, as long as you don't have more than N(N < 30000) yuan money." Early this morning, Jin Ming began to make a budget, but he wanted to buy too many things, will certainly exceed the mother's limit of N yuan. So he specified an important point for each item, divided into 5th class: denoted by the integer 1−5, and the 5th most important. He also found the price of each item (all integers and less than 10000) on the Internet. He hopes that the sum of the price and importance of each item will be the largest, without more than N yuan (which can be equal to N yuan).
Let the price of the j item v[j], the importance of w[j], a total of k items, the number of j1, j2, ..., jk, the sum of the required is:
v[j1]×w[j1]+v[j2]×w[j2]+...+v[jk]×w[jk]×w[jk].
Please help Jin Ming design a shopping list that meets the requirements. What the algorithm should be use to pass this question?
7.analysis: 由于数据量很大，暴力破解必超时，所以首先排除D，其次因为要求全局最优，贪心也排除，这里符合背包的特征：有物品选择且有限制，但由于物品只能选一次，所以用01背包。
